title: È decisa la lite
subtitle: Don Curzio, Marcellina, Figaro, the Count and Bartolo: recitative from Le nozze di Figaro, Act 3
note: The judge rules that Figaro must pay or marry Marcellina
about: Score: the recitative “È decisa la lite” (vocal score pages 224-227, 38 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
